column1: # Where the series the dashboards of the tree query come from, for tests/dashboards.bats. A row is,
# separated by tabs: the name of the GrafanaDashboard; a metric name, as an anchored regular
# expression; where it comes from; and, for some, a note. The rows of a dashboard are tried in
# order, and the first whose expression is the whole name says where the metric comes from:
#   Kind/name      a monitor of the render that scrapes the target that serves it; several,
#                  separated by commas, where one of them in the render is enough, as the monitors
#                  of the PostgreSQL instances come and go with the applications that have a database
#   any-monitor    a series Prometheus writes for every target it scrapes
#   alerting-rule  the series Prometheus writes for every alerting rule
#   none           nothing serves it, so the panel is empty here: the note says why
# A row whose second cell is __name__, or a variable as ${name}, pins as unread:<n> how many
# expressions of the dashboard name a metric by a regular expression on __name__, or by that
# variable: the test does not read them, and the note says what they are. A series a recording rule
# of the render writes needs no row. The test fails for a metric no row names, for a monitor the
# render lacks or that drops the metric, and for a row that names nothing its dashboard reads. A
# dashboard written for this tree, and the home, name each metric literally, with its monitor; the
# note says where the source of what serves it defines it, at the version the tree pins, for a
# metric no alert of the tree reads.
